whenToUse: You show a short profile for a name, such as a mention in a comment.
Previewing a link before opening it would help.
The information is nice to know but not necessary.
whenNotToUse: The card needs controls such as buttons or inputs (use a popover).
Touch is the main way people use it (there's no hover).
The information is essential to the task.

alternatives.name: Popover
alternatives.reason: Opened by a click and used from inside.

accessibility: It also opens right away on keyboard focus, and Esc closes it.
An opening delay (0.5 seconds) keeps the card from flashing when the pointer only passes over the link, and a closing delay lets the pointer move onto the card.
The card only repeats what the link points to, so it's aria-hidden and contains nothing focusable.
The link itself leads to the full information, so people who never see the card can still reach it.
